question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage discusses the** concentrations of greenhouse gases (GHG) that affect the Earth's atmosphere.**
 
• The** appropriate verb** should indicate the function of these gases in relation to heat.
 
• **"Trap"** is the** most appropriate** word as it means to capture and hold, which accurately describes how GHGs retain heat in the atmosphere.
 
• Other options ("**bark**", "**waste**", "**hang**") do not fit the context of discussing the mechanism of greenhouse gases.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 1 is** 'trap.'**
 
• **Hence, the correct sentence from the passage is "****The concentrations of greenhouse gases (GHG) that trap__ heat in the Earth's atmosphere rose to record ..............."**
